issues.description: The problem statement and UML require a Lecture constructor that initializes five attributes (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors) in that order, but the template's Lecture class provides a constructor with only three parameters (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents). The solution implements the five-parameter constructor. This mismatch in the template constructor signature can confuse students about the expected constructor and prevent them from following the specified design.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the template Lecture class to provide the constructor signature that matches the UML and problem description: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors). The constructor body can remain a TODO or perform straightforward assignments (as in the solution) so students are not misled by an incomplete/incorrect signature.
